column1: # Windows batch counters (.bat, .cmd), for a rule with the prompt file-body-fallback: one per line,
# label TAB pattern (Java regex), keywords in any case as cmd.exe reads them. The [ignore] line
# blanks REM and :: comment lines and a REM after an & (echo x & rem note), so a "goto" in a comment
# at the start of a line (a call or goto target); "variables set" every set, set /a and set /p, also
# after an if or in a for body; "conditionals (approx)" every if, an "if" an echo prints too; "for
# loops" a for over a %variable, with its options or the root of a /r; "error level checks" every
# errorlevel. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that
